chicken.label: chicken
chicken.cook: Grill over direct medium heat, 6–7 minutes a side, to 175°F internal. Thighs want to go past 165°F — that is where they turn tender.
chicken.reheat: Warm the sliced chicken in a covered skillet with a splash of water or broth. The steam is what keeps it from drying out.
chicken.prep: Pat dry and season at least 20 minutes ahead.

turkey.label: ground turkey
turkey.cook: Brown in a heavy pot in batches. Let it sit undisturbed to build a crust before breaking it up.
turkey.reheat: Warm gently with a splash of water — it dries out fast.
turkey.prep: Buy plain ground turkey, not seasoned patties.

salmon.label: salmon
salmon.cook: Roast skin-down at 400°F for 12–14 minutes. Pull it while the center is still slightly translucent.
salmon.reheat: Do not. Flake it cold into the dish and let residual heat warm it through.
salmon.prep: Salt 30 minutes ahead and leave uncovered in the fridge.

whitefish.label: white fish
whitefish.cook: Roast at 400°F for 10–12 minutes until it flakes under light pressure.
whitefish.reheat: Serve cold and flaked, or warm very gently in a covered pan.
whitefish.prep: Pat very dry — wet fish steams instead of browning.

swordfish.label: swordfish
swordfish.cook: Grill over direct high heat about 4 minutes a side. It overcooks fast — pull it the moment it flakes but still holds together.
swordfish.reheat: Serve cold and flaked. Reheating turns it tough.
swordfish.prep: Oil the steaks, not the grate.

shrimp.label: shrimp
shrimp.cook: Grill over high heat 2 minutes a side. Done the moment they curl into a C — a tight O means overcooked.
shrimp.reheat: Poorly. Cook shrimp fresh the night you eat it.
shrimp.prep: Buy plain — pre-marinated shrimp is almost always garlic-forward.

tofu.label: tofu
tofu.cook: Press 45 minutes, cube, toss in cornstarch, air fry at 400°F for 14 minutes, shaking halfway.
tofu.reheat: Air fry 5 minutes at 375°F to bring the crust back.
tofu.prep: Press it Sunday and leave it in marinade — it needs no cooking until you want it.

beans.label: white beans
beans.cook: Simmer with the aromatics 15 minutes, mashing some against the pot to thicken.
beans.reheat: Warm with a splash of water; they thicken overnight.
beans.prep: Rinse well. Skip anything labeled seasoned or chili-style.

eggs.label: eggs
eggs.cook: Jammy-boil 7 minutes, then ice bath. They keep peeled for four days.

artichoke.label: artichoke hearts
artichoke.cook: Halve, pat very dry, bread, and bake at 425°F for 20 minutes until browned and crisp.
artichoke.reheat: Air fry 5 minutes at 375°F. They lose their crunch fast, so bread them Sunday and bake the night you eat them.
artichoke.prep: Drain and dry thoroughly — wet artichokes will not take breading.

chickpeas.label: chickpeas
chickpeas.cook: Dry well, toss with oil and smoked paprika, roast at 425°F for 25 minutes until they rattle.
chickpeas.reheat: Air fry 4 minutes at 375°F to bring back the crunch.
chickpeas.prep: Rinse and dry on a towel. Skip seasoned varieties.

beef.label: beef
beef.cook: Grill over high heat 4–5 minutes a side for medium-rare, then rest 10 minutes before slicing against the grain.
beef.reheat: Warm gently, covered, with a splash of broth — red meat overcooks fast on a second pass.
beef.prep: Salt at least 40 minutes ahead, or overnight, and bring to room temperature before it hits the grill.
beef.accommodateNote: Grill or sear a portion of chicken thighs or salmon alongside with the same rub, for your spouse's plate — same timing as the household default, different protein.

pork.label: pork
pork.cook: Tenderloin: grill or roast to 140–145°F, about 20 minutes. Shoulder: smoke low and slow to 195°F for pulling.
pork.reheat: Warm with a splash of liquid, covered — pork dries out fast reheated uncovered.
pork.prep: Trim the silver skin off tenderloin before cooking.
pork.accommodateNote: Cook a portion of chicken thighs the same way for your spouse — same rub, same pan or smoker, pulled a bit earlier since poultry cooks faster.

groundbeef.label: ground beef
groundbeef.cook: Brown in a hot pan in batches, breaking it up once it's developed a crust, not before.
groundbeef.reheat: Warm gently with a splash of water or sauce.
groundbeef.prep: Don't crowd the pan or it steams instead of browning.
groundbeef.accommodateNote: Brown a half-pound of ground turkey separately, same seasoning, same pan — it's a small enough batch to cook alongside without extra dishes.

rice.label: rice
rice.cook: Rice cooker, double batch. Spread on a sheet pan to cool before storing.
rice.reheat: Add a tablespoon of water per cup and cover.

tortilla.label: corn tortillas
tortilla.reheat: 20 seconds a side in a dry skillet.

potato.label: potatoes
potato.cook: Boil until fork-tender, smash on an oiled sheet pan, roast at 450°F for 35 minutes.
potato.reheat: Air fryer, 400°F for 6 minutes. They come back almost new.

sweetpotato.label: sweet potatoes
sweetpotato.cook: Bake whole at 400°F for 50 minutes until collapsing.
sweetpotato.reheat: Air fryer, 380°F for 8 minutes — the skin re-crisps.

pasta.label: GF pasta
pasta.cook: Boil to just under package time, drain, rinse cold, toss with oil.
pasta.reheat: Warm directly in sauce with a splash of pasta water.
pasta.accommodateNote: Boil a small separate pot of GF penne or spaghetti for your spouse — a cup dry is plenty for one serving. Keep it in its own pot; GF pasta clouds the water fast.
